inventory.notes: File mixes two features: this spoof part (popup default position, which a page reads as screenX/screenY, and the chrome flags) and the Juggler flag JUGGLER_WINDOW_EXPLICIT_SIZE (feature juggler-popup-explicit-size, see nsIWebBrowserChrome.idl). Split them in the series. Verified: StealthDeclarationGate.h is gfx/thebes/StealthDeclarationGate.h (struct StealthWindowFrame line 124, StealthDeclaredWindowFrame line 135). Chrome callers keep stock behaviour. The B258 reference is the author's.
